obligations.description: Reject directory traversal ('..'), drive-letter colons, UNC paths, and Win32 reserved DOS device names before loose-file VFS lookup, and acquire std::shared_lock<std::shared_mutex> on g_archiveMapMutex during Kongor_NativeGuard_VfsFindFile.
Replace linear console command prefix scans with a 128-bucket case-insensitive hash table whose collision chains are sorted alphabetically with early break when stricmp(entry.name, query) > 0.

Split multi-command console buffers on ';' and '\n' only when outside double quotes, cap command buffers at 16384 characters, and block privileged/unsafe commands when dispatched from untrusted IPC sources.

Allocate uncompSize + 2 bytes for VFS decompression buffers, write a guaranteed trailing null byte (0x00) at [uncompSize] and a tail canary byte (0xDF) at [uncompSize + 1], and verify both bytes immediately after extraction.

Write and flush the Tier-1 minimal minidump (MiniDumpNormal | MiniDumpWithThreadInfo) FIRST before attempting the Tier-2 rich dump, and emit a 16-frame zero-allocation SEH-guarded Module+RVA stack walk into the stack-allocated crash banner.

Wrap native diagnostic format-string evaluation in an SEH __try / __except guard (SehSafeVsnprintf) that recovers with a deterministic '[SEH-FORMAT-FAULT]' fallback message on bad pointer dereferences.

Enforce non-overlapping half-open patch intervals [target_rva, target_rva + patch_len) in RuntimePatchController::RegisterPatchSite and BinaryOverlayAndIpsPatchService::ValidateNonOverlappingPatchIntervals, rejecting colliding detour/NOP windows with '[RE2X64-OVERLAP]' before writing code bytes.
